explanation: Born in Poland, he spent his adult years mainly in Paris. As he wished, his heart was carried back to Warsaw and sealed in a pillar of the Holy Cross Church.

claims.text: Almost all of Chopin's works are for the piano, either solo or with other instruments or voice.
Chopin's works without piano are very few, and he wrote nothing for solo violin, solo cello or organ.
Chopin was born in Poland and spent his adult years mainly in Paris.
At Chopin's request, his heart was taken to Warsaw and sealed in a pillar of the Holy Cross Church.
